title: Birbal and the Mango Tree
moral: The true owner is the one who truly cares.

scenes.text: One day, two men came to Emperor Akbar. Both claimed that a mango tree belonged to them.

story: One day, two men came to Emperor Akbar with a problem. They both claimed ownership of a mango tree. One man said he planted and cared for it, while the other said it was his. Akbar was confused and asked Birbal for help. Birbal made a plan. He told a guard to inform them that the tree had been stolen. The first man became worried and rushed to check it. The second man remained calm. Birbal said the worried man was the true owner. Akbar agreed and gave him the tree.
